hook.es: Para cualquiera es una computadora. Para ellos es una nave.
hook.en: To anyone else, it's a computer. To them, it's a ship.

objective: A borrowed gaming PC arrives and is converted into a worker in the Parallel World. NØVA realizes any machine can be connected if you know how.

scenes.visuals: A weathered, powered-down ship-like machine drifts into view at the edge of the Parallel World — actually a borrowed gaming PC, reimagined
The Traveler and NØVA together at a workbench, hands-on, wiring the machine back to life, gears and glowing panels around them
scenes.copy: The Traveler y NØVA la repararon juntos.

scenes.visuals: NØVA looking at the half-repaired machine, head tilted
scenes.copy: NØVA — "¿Es nuestra?" The Traveler — "No." NØVA — "¿Entonces para qué la arreglamos?"

scenes.visuals: The Traveler finishing the last connection, the machine's lights coming on
scenes.copy: The Traveler — "Porque mientras esté aquí, puede ayudarnos a llegar más lejos."

scenes.visuals: The now-glowing ship-machine lifts and takes its place among the Parallel World's other structures
scenes.copy: NØVA — "¿Entonces podemos convertir cualquier máquina en parte del mundo?" The Traveler — "Si sabemos conectarla."

captions.es: Una nave prestada. Un mundo un poco más grande.
captions.en: A borrowed ship. A slightly bigger world.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The gaming PC transformed into a ship-like worker form, glowing, The Traveler and NØVA standing beside it
